intended_contract.outcome: Return one terminal, read-only judgment of one immutable ordinary diff against its fixed point, with Standards and Spec judged separately and every admitted finding verified and actionable.
invocation: An ordinary branch diff needs review.
A caller-bounded since-X diff needs review.

exclusions.condition: The target is a local pull request, release candidate, or bounded high-risk diff.
exclusions.return: Route to convergent-pr-review without beginning ordinary review.

exclusions.condition: The target is an immutable repository baseline needing an open-ended correctness, domain-robustness, methodology, model-risk, leakage, validation, analytics, or performance audit.
exclusions.return: Route to audit-codebase without beginning ordinary review.

exclusions.condition: The request is implementation, repair, or mutation rather than judgment of an existing diff.
exclusions.return: Return the mismatch to the caller; review grants no mutation.

authority.caller: Owns the Spec, Charter, Source Trace, commitment boundary, supplied fixed point, risk classification, finding admission for repair, residual-risk acceptance, mutation, and successor snapshot.
authority.review: Owns bounded read-only inspection, evidence-backed judgment, finding admission into the report, coverage accounting, and the terminal review status for the pinned snapshot.
authority.repository: Owns local instructions, domain decisions, maintained proof lanes, conventions, and configured tracker semantics.
authority.review_limits: The reviewer does not edit, stage, commit, repair, mutate tracker state, accept residual risk, or authorize a successor snapshot.

caller_obligations: Name or make discoverable one target diff.
Supply a fixed point when one is required by the calling workflow; a caller-supplied fixed point wins.
Supply Spec, Charter, Source Trace, required proof, skips, and risk when the caller requires them.
For Spec-required review, provide enough originating commitment to judge the Spec axis.
relationship_obligations: Skill-router selects review only for an ordinary branch, WIP, staged, or since-X diff needing judgment.

Implement supplies the required Spec, Charter, Source Trace, fixed point, exact candidate, proof, skips, and risk, then accepts only a complete current review with no admitted blocker or unaccepted residual.
Parallel-implement supplies Spec required yes, Charter, Source Trace, fixed point, target, and required proof; it alone may ask the caller to admit a complete blocking set.
Convergent-pr-review owns local PR, release-candidate, and bounded high-risk review.
Audit-codebase owns immutable repository-baseline audits without a release decision.
intended_contract.safe_failure_return: Return Review status: incomplete with the pinned identities, covered work, verified findings and carried dispositions, exact blocker or drift, skipped work, residual risk, and the caller-only authority boundary. Preserve partial evidence without claiming complete coverage.
completion: The review mode, fixed point, snapshot identity, and target are explicit.
Every in-scope changed surface and required source is either inspected or named under skipped work and blocks complete status when material.
Standards and Spec are judged separately.
Every reported finding satisfies the Finding Contract and is supported by current evidence.
The snapshot is read back and has not drifted.
The report states Return boundary: caller, Mutation authority: none, and Successor snapshot authority: none.
The reviewer stops after one terminal report.
required_order: Route the target type before substantive review.
Pin the fixed point and exact review snapshot before judgment.
Trace governing sources and required proof before admitting findings.
Judge Standards and Spec separately before rendering the report.
Admit only verified findings, then read back snapshot identity for drift.
Return one terminal report and stop before mutation or successor work.
safety: Review is read-only over repository, index, worktree, tracker, connector, and remote state.
A focused or structural proxy is reported as such and never promoted to semantic or runtime proof.
Unsupported possibilities are omitted rather than reported as findings.
Unrelated work and untracked content remain unchanged.
Snapshot drift invalidates terminal complete status; baseline movement alone does not rewrite the caller-supplied fixed point.
A finding or report grants no implementation, repair, staging, commit, tracker, push, or successor authority.

semantic_units.entry_case: Ordinary branch, WIP, staged, or since-X diff.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: High-risk, PR, release-candidate, baseline-audit, or implementation target.
semantic_units.failure_return: Routing blocker naming the correct owner; no review or mutation begun.
semantic_units.proof: Routing fixtures cover every accepted form and every exclusion.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Use a caller-supplied fixed point; otherwise discover the default branch and merge base, and return ambiguity before judgment.
semantic_units.entry_case: Exact caller fixed point or unambiguous default-branch merge base.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report naming the baseline blocker.
semantic_units.proof: Cases for supplied baseline, discovered baseline, and ambiguous baseline.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Capture the target identity including applicable HEAD, index tree, staged diff, unstaged diff, status, and untracked paths and content before inspection.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Target identity cannot be captured completely.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report with the missing identity surface.
semantic_units.proof: Identity cases for committed, staged, unstaged, mixed, and untracked targets.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Read the applicable user request, Spec, Charter, Source Trace, repo instructions, domain decisions, diff, tests, proof, skips, and risk without treating narration as proof.
semantic_units.entry_case: Required sources are present and readable.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: A decision-bearing source is missing, contradictory, or inaccessible.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report naming the exact source and affected axis.
semantic_units.proof: Source-complete, optional-Source, missing-Spec-required, and contradictory-source cases.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Inspect every in-scope changed surface and semantic interaction; account explicitly for skipped work.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: A material path, generated artifact, dependency effect, or proof seam cannot be inspected.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report with covered and skipped work plus residual risk.
semantic_units.proof: Multi-file and partial-access fixtures verify complete accounting.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Judge whether the candidate is built right under documented repository standards, maintainability constraints, and concrete actionable risk.
semantic_units.entry_case: Repository conventions and candidate evidence are available.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: A preference lacks documented or concrete risk support.
semantic_units.failure_return: Omit unsupported preference; incomplete only when a required Standards source is unavailable.
semantic_units.proof: Defect, supported-maintainability, preference-only, and clean cases.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Judge whether the candidate is the right thing against originating commitments, separate from Standards.
semantic_units.entry_case: Spec is supplied or discoverable; Spec-required callers identify it.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Spec required yes but the commitment source is missing or contradictory.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report naming the Spec blocker without folding it into Standards.
semantic_units.proof: Spec pass, Spec defect, Spec-not-required, and missing-Spec-required cases.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Admit a finding only when a supported scenario, current evidence, violated expectation, location, impact, and required proof make it actionable.
semantic_units.entry_case: Evidence establishes a concrete in-scope defect.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Possibility, preference, duplicate, disproved concern, or unverifiable claim.
semantic_units.failure_return: Omit unsupported claims and carry any material evidence gap in the terminal report.
semantic_units.proof: Verified, unsupported, duplicate, disproved, and evidence-gap cases.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Give each accepted finding all required fields: ID, Axis, Severity, Location, Anchor, Supported scenario, Evidence, Impact, Blocking, Remediation, and Required proof.
semantic_units.entry_case: One or more verified findings exist.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Any required field is missing or ambiguous.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete finding/report; grant no repair authority.
semantic_units.proof: Parse every finding and require the exact field set.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Order verified defects P0 through P3 by impact, state blocking explicitly, and classify remediation as automatic-in-scope, decision-required, or residual-hardening without granting repair.
semantic_units.entry_case: A verified finding has established impact and work shape.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Impact, Charter preservation, scope, or proof need is uncertain.
semantic_units.failure_return: Use decision-required or report the classification gap; never infer repair authority.
semantic_units.proof: Each severity and remediation class plus ambiguous-classification cases.

semantic_units.neutral_expression: Report Standards findings and Spec findings separately, including explicit clean results, and preserve material carried dispositions or disputes without inflating them into findings.
semantic_units.entry_case: Judgment for both applicable axes is complete.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: An axis or material prior disposition is silently omitted.
semantic_units.failure_return: Incomplete report identifying the omitted axis or disposition.
semantic_units.proof: Clean, one-axis finding, both-axis finding, and carried-disposition cases.

semantic_units.behavior: Read back snapshot identity and detect drift
semantic_units.neutral_expression: Before Return, recapture every applicable snapshot surface and compare it with the pinned identity.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: HEAD, index tree, staged diff, unstaged diff, status, or untracked path/content changed.
semantic_units.failure_return: Review status incomplete with exact drift; preserve findings as snapshot-bound evidence.
semantic_units.proof: No-drift and one controlled drift per applicable surface.

semantic_units.behavior: Return complete only under full coverage
semantic_units.neutral_expression: Return Review status complete only when target identity, sources, coverage, both applicable axes, finding admission, proof accounting, and drift checks are complete; otherwise return the exact incomplete form.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: Any material gate is unproved, skipped, contradictory, or drifted.
semantic_units.failure_return: The ordered incomplete report with blocker, skips, residual risk, and drift.
semantic_units.proof: One green complete case and one failing case per completion gate.

semantic_units.behavior: Return authority to the caller and stop
semantic_units.neutral_expression: End the one terminal report with caller Return, no mutation authority, and no successor snapshot authority.
semantic_units.entry_case: Complete or incomplete terminal report is ready.
semantic_units.wrong_condition_case: The reviewer begins repair, editing, staging, tracker mutation, commit, push, or successor review.
semantic_units.failure_return: Stop and report the authority violation or attempted expansion.
semantic_units.proof: Structural checks for the three literal authority lines and behavior cases that tempt repair or successor work.
